chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakūnī:
That Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام ruled that, regarding the spine, if it is broken, the blood money is due.

key_terms.الدِّيَةَ: blood money; the prescribed financial compensation for bodily injury
key_terms.الصُّلْبِ: the spine or backbone, the bodily part under discussion in the ruling
key_terms.انْكَسَرَ: was broken, describing the injury that triggers liability
key_terms.قَضَى: ruled or adjudicated, indicating a formal judicial decision

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on diya when a person’s spine is broken?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام concerning bodily injury. It states that when the spine is broken, full diya is payable, showing the seriousness of such harm in Islamic law.
